tools.name: prepare_api_exchange
tools.description: Free validation before buying a receipt. Supply an event built locally with the SDK from real captured bytes; never fabricate hashes. Returns the commitment without issuing a receipt or paying. Use when retaining verifiable evidence of an API response for a handoff or archive.

tools.name: issue_api_receipt
tools.description: Buy a portable signed commitment to a declared API exchange when a recipient needs independently verifiable receipt integrity: response handoff, archived decision input, or change investigation. Costs 0.002 USDC per receipt via x402 when enabled; verification is free. A local log may suffice for dis

tools.name: verify_api_receipt
tools.description: Free signature and declaration verification. To try before buying, read datoka-api://demo-receipt or /demo/receipt.json and pass the returned JSON here. No wallet needed for public verification. Verifies issuer, scope and event commitment; compare original response bytes locally with the SDK or /ver

tools.name: get_api_public_keys
tools.description: Return issuer public keys. Establish issuer trust independently before offline verification.
